name: @intentqa/mcp

tools.name: intentqa_context
tools.description: Everything needed to author a test here, in one call: the catalog (the only vocabulary a feature file may use), the declared control inventory, project config, existing feature files, the authoring workflow, the refusals, and the exit-code contract. Call this first.

cwd.description: Project directory containing intentqa.config.ts. Defaults to the server's working directory.

tools.name: intentqa_catalog
tools.description: The registered steps and assertions. `view: "json"` gives full parameter schemas, "prompt" gives the compact one-line-per-entry rendering the planner sees, and "snippets" gives pasteable Gherkin lines. A feature file may use nothing else.

cwd.description: Project directory containing intentqa.config.ts. Defaults to the server's working directory.

tools.name: intentqa_explain
tools.description: One step or assertion in detail: its parameters, their types and allowed values, its risk tier, and a Gherkin line ready to adapt. Use this instead of guessing at a phrase's parameters. An unknown id comes back with the nearest registered match.

cwd.description: Project directory containing intentqa.config.ts. Defaults to the server's working directory.

tools.name: intentqa_validate_feature
tools.description: Resolve Gherkin source against the catalog and report every unresolved line, with the nearest registered phrase for each. Writes nothing — no file, no spec, no git change. Iterate here until `ok` is true, then write the file and call intentqa_generate.

cwd.description: Project directory containing intentqa.config.ts. Defaults to the server's working directory.

source.description: The full Gherkin text to check.

label.description: Name to report problems against. Defaults to <draft>.

tools.name: intentqa_controls
tools.description: The test ids the suite depends on. With `check` and a `url`, opens the page and reports which ids the application does not carry yet — the list to turn into a pull request against the app. Never ask a model to invent a selector instead; that is refused.

cwd.description: Project directory containing intentqa.config.ts. Defaults to the server's working directory.

check.description: Check against a live page. Needs @playwright/test and a running app.

url.description: Path or URL to check. Required with check.

role.description: Sign in as this role first, for a gated page.

tools.name: intentqa_lint
tools.description: Hard sleeps, focused tests, stale generated specs, and — when enforceControls is on — raw locators inside step files. Exits with findings rather than fixing anything.

cwd.description: Project directory containing intentqa.config.ts. Defaults to the server's working directory.

tools.name: intentqa_audit
tools.description: Vocabulary size and reuse metrics, failing over the configured budget. Run this before adding a step: the answer is often that an existing phrase already covers the case.

cwd.description: Project directory containing intentqa.config.ts. Defaults to the server's working directory.

tools.name: intentqa_check
tools.description: generate --check plus lint, formatting and near-duplicate vocabulary detection. This is what CI runs. Get this to exit 0 before reporting the work finished.

cwd.description: Project directory containing intentqa.config.ts. Defaults to the server's working directory.

tools.name: intentqa_trace
tools.description: Requirement-to-test coverage from @req: tags on features and scenarios. Answers which requirements have no test and which tests claim no requirement.

cwd.description: Project directory containing intentqa.config.ts. Defaults to the server's working directory.

tools.name: intentqa_triage
tools.description: Classify failures in a Playwright JSON report into defects, drift, environment problems and flakes. Use this after running the suite in a shell, so a failure gets read as a cause rather than a retry.

cwd.description: Project directory containing intentqa.config.ts. Defaults to the server's working directory.

report.description: Report path, relative to cwd. Defaults to playwright-report/report.json.

failOnBugs.description: Report an error for defects and drift only, ignoring flakes.

tools.name: intentqa_generate
tools.description: Compile every feature file under featureDirs into Playwright specs under specDir. WRITES FILES. Validate drafts with intentqa_validate_feature first. Pass `check: true` for a read-only drift report — that is what CI uses and it writes nothing.

cwd.description: Project directory containing intentqa.config.ts. Defaults to the server's working directory.

check.description: Report drift instead of writing. Read-only.

tools.name: intentqa_propose
tools.description: The correct move when nothing in the catalog fits. Queues a markdown draft under proposalsDir for a human to turn into a real step, and does NOT create a step. WRITES A FILE. After calling this, stop and report the gap — do not work around it.

cwd.description: Project directory containing intentqa.config.ts. Defaults to the server's working directory.

intent.description: What the missing step should do, in plain language.

annotations.title: Propose a vocabulary gap (writes a file)

tools.name: intentqa_rules
tools.description: The authoring workflow, the things this tool refuses to do, and the exit-code contract. Cheap to call and does not load the project — useful when intentqa_context fails because there is no config yet.

cwd.description: Project directory containing intentqa.config.ts. Defaults to the server's working directory.

instructions: intentqa compiles plain-language feature files into reviewable Playwright specs. Call `intentqa_context` first: it returns the catalog, which is the only vocabulary a feature file may use. Draft Gherkin from those phrases, check it with `intentqa_validate_feature` (which writes nothing), and only then write the file and call `intentqa_generate`. Never invent a step phrase or a locator.
